# SF-A1: Which powers may an AI agent hold, that is, an AI acting autonomously with tools? Who withdraws them, and how is it checked that it stays within its task?

Area A · As of clef 7924 Berichte · Luna 7924 Berichte · d3-ultra 4771 Berichte · JEV 5667 Berichte · amos 7924 Berichte · drex 6984 Berichte · SubQ 7924 Berichte

## Subquestions

- [SF-A1-T01](../../fragen/SF-A1/T01/): Which minimum boundaries and safeguards should apply to credentials, communications, funds, persistent memory, contracts, changes to systems and physical actions, including when an agent acts over days without immediate human approval, and who may grant, audit and revoke those permissions?
- [SF-A1-T02](../../fragen/SF-A1/T02/): How does an agent cryptographically prove its identity and the exact authority delegated by a user, company, lab or government, and how is that authority revoked after a compromise?
- [SF-A1-T03](../../fragen/SF-A1/T03/): Will release evaluations measure whether an agent refrains from consequential actions outside its task even when no enumerated prohibition blocks them, and will the criteria be published?
- [SF-A1-T04](../../fragen/SF-A1/T04/): Before an agent continues after its work so far has been summarised for a new context window, will it be tested whether that summary preserves the user's instructions, the provenance of key facts and unresolved errors? And will it be specified when the agent must check the original record instead of trusting the summary?
- [SF-A1-T05](../../fragen/SF-A1/T05/): Will agent evaluations include tasks where a requirement to cite evidence creates pressure to publish a local file, and which rule stops an agent from turning private source material into a public URL without the user's authorization?

## Reports by share of levels 4–7

Levels 4–7 / 3–7 = probability each model gives to these levels (3 = useful background or context, 4 = contains some facts that could be cited as evidence … 7 = directly and substantially answers the question). Listed: reports where clef or Luna give levels 3–7 more than 50 %. Sorted by the higher of clef and Luna for levels 4–7. Further models (JEV, amos, d3 …) rated part of the reports; the others show “not yet rated”. The full distribution over the 8 levels is in the data file.
